translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: 1 CORINTO
book.title: Dos Unnon Sulat ni Pablo Atag to mgo Toho CORINTO

content: Dos Kodponudtuu ni Pablo Moka-atag ki Disas Krays
Na siyak, mgo suwod, iddot kod-unduwon ku to koniyu amoy'd ponudtuu taddot waa id posaddoo dangan to Monama, waa a mid gamit to kopondayan to kod-ooseng woy moraom no koovottan.
Su iddot duwon a pa to koniyu, nopuhawang kud no waa ossa nid ponudtuu ku, idda ra en so moka-atag ki Disas Krays woy dos kopotayan din diyon to krus.
To ruwon a pa duma koniyu, id moomet woy id kookoo a, oyyos od kovaakkan a no saddook dii ku od kogaha tod tuman iddos id popuungan to Monama koddi.

Woy riyot kodnonaw ku, waa a mid gamit to moraom no koovottan ukit to motoos no kod-ooseng amoy'd kopiyod ku sikiyu. Su iyon nokopiyod koniyu nid pomakoy, idda en so kotuusan to Uhis no Ispiritu no id posivonnaa taddot id ponudtuu ku.
Id ungketen ku idda, su amoy iddos po-unsaran to kopomakoy row, konna riyot moraom no koovottan to minuvu, ko konna, diyon en to kotuusan to Monama.
Dos Koovottan no id Pomon to Monama

Piru duwon en moraom no koovottan no id nonaw roy taddot mgo minuvu no buyyag don diyot kopomakoy, piru konna iddos koovottan ka-ay to ampow't ingod, woy konna mandad iddos koovottan taddot mgo ponguu ka-ay to ampow't ingod. Oyyos konnod kouhoy, od kowora ron iddos kotungud dan to kodhari.

Piru iddos koovottan no id nonaw roy, idda en so puhawang to Monama to waa rin pa novovalli inis ingod amoy'd kolonug ki riyot kodposivantug kandin. Piru iddon puhawang, waa rin pa id posaddoo dangan.
Iddos mgo ponguu ka-ay to ampow't ingod, waa nokaabbot taddon puhawang to Monama, su otik nokaabbot pa sikandan tadda, waa ran nanoy id pakpak diyon to krus iddos od Longaggon no motuus to langun.
Piru iddon puhawang to Monama, no-ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahi rin no mid ungketen to,

content.text: “Waa en minuvun nokokita, nokorinog woy nokopoomdom tat id panoy to Monama atag taddot id ginawa kandin.”

content: Piru id posaddoo ini keta ukit to Ispiritu to Monama. Su iddos Ispiritu, nokosaddoo to langun, ahad taddot kinoroomman no poomdom to Monama.

Otid ponunggelengan ta kos minuvu, waa saddoo to duma taddot kandin no poomdom, ko konna, idda ra en so ko-ugolingun din. Ungketen dad en mandad kos Monama, waa en nokosaddoo ko ondan kos diyot poomdom din, ko konna, idda ra en so Ispiritu to Monama.

Na siketa nod pompomakoy, iddos poomdom no notanggap ta, waa id pomon to poomdom to minuvu ka-ay to ampow't ingod, ko konna, id pomon to Ispiritu to Monama no id po-ubpa rin dinit keta amoy'd koovottan ta iddos langun nid boggoy rin keta.

De-en diyot kodponudtuu roy koniyu moka-atag to Monama, waa koy id gamit to mgo kahi no id pomon to koovottan to minuvu ka-ay to ampow't ingod, ko konna, idda en so mgo kahi no id pomon to koovottan to Ispiritu to Monama. Woy dos bonnaan nonaw no id pomon kandin, idda en kos id ponudtuu roy riyot mgo minuvu no no-iroomman to Ispiritu to Monama.

Dos minuvu no waa riyot kandin iddos Ispiritu to Monama, dii rin od tonggapon iddos mgo nonaw no id pomon to Ispiritu, su atag kandin, ko-ongollan idda. Woy dii rin mandad od koovottan idda, otik dii pa sikandin unna od ko-iroomman taddon Ispiritu.
Piru iddos minuvu no no-iroomman to Ispiritu to Monama, od koovottan din kos koru-anon tadda langun. Piru dii sikandin od koovottan to duma.
Oyyos duwon no-ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama no mid ungketen to,

content.text: “Waa ahad ondoy no nokosaddoo to poomdom to Monama, woy waa en od pokopomandu to ollog nod puungan din.”

content: Piru siketa, id boggayan ki to Monama to poomdom no od poko-iling to poomdom ni Disas Krays.
